{{Top|leg}}
A '''laser cutting blade''' was a component of a [[servocutter]], consisting of a disc small enough to fit into a pocket.

Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]] once used several laser cutting blades as impromptu weapons. He threw the blades by hand to ward off the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and was able to make a crack in Fett's armor.
